findings.title: Negative integer quantities are accepted and persisted with negative totals
findings.expected: CART-2: reject negative quantities with 400 and preserve previous cart state.
findings.actual: PUT quantity -1 returned 200 twice; independent GETs returned quantity -1, totalItems -1 and totalPrice -12.
findings.impact: Authenticated caller can persist an invalid cart quantity and negative displayed totals in their own cart.

risks.reason: Missing lower bound in Store.update matches two confirmed HTTP failures.
risks.next_probe: After fix, assert -1 returns 400 and GET preserves prior cart; add domain regression.

risks.reason: Store.cart hardcodes 12; current fixture price is also 12, so no discrepancy demonstrated.
risks.next_probe: Use separately authorized varying-price fixture and compare totals to catalog.

risks.reason: Source deletes item; no API re-add operation exists, and live zero was skipped to preserve restorability.
risks.next_probe: With resettable fixture lifecycle, update zero and verify empty cart and zero totals.

risks.reason: Anonymous reads/writes and two valid identities were tested, but malformed or invalid bearer credentials were not.
risks.next_probe: Check invalid bearer identity yields rejection without cart mutation.
